review: I really like how GVQ Microgreens makes fresh, healthy greens so easy to bring into daily life. It’s simple, sustainable, and feels like the future of farming in the city!
Have been a subscriber for Microgreens for one month now. Got GVQ Microgreens and they’re genuinely fresh and crisp — zero wilt, crazy flavor.
I’ve recently started using these microgreens and I’m genuinely impressed with the quality and freshness.
I’ve had a great experience with GVQ Microgreens. The quality is excellent and always fresh.
Superb quality and excellent service. The subscription box is very convenient.
